messages.subject: grid.clip and ggplot2
parts:
Dear all,

As daft as it may sound, I'm trying to clip a ggplot2 to a particular
viewport without success. For example,

p = qplot(1:10)
g = ggplotGrob(p)

grid.clip(x = 0.3, width = 0.1)
grid.circle(gp=gpar(fill="red"))

grid.newpage()

grid.clip(x = 0.3, width = 0.1)
grid.draw(g)

Is it currently impossible?

I thought it'd be handy to illustrate specific theme settings.

Best,

baptiste

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: grid.clip and ggplot2
parts:
> I should indeed look at the source code! However I wanted to know
> whether it was intentional or not that a high-level ggplot2 grob
> should not respect such a clipping region.

From the documentation of clipGrob:

Pushing or popping a viewport _always_ overrides the clip region
set by a clip grob, regardless of whether that viewport explicitly
enforces a clipping region.

And ggplot2 uses lots of viewports, so I don't think clipGrob is the
way to enforce clipping. Instead, I think you want to create a new
viewport and draw the ggplot2 grob inside of that.

Hadley
